reason: waits on execute_code read-only/propose-only credential admission; the current typed door requires core:write

currentTypedRequest.task: Read cobalt-execute-preference using vault.recall at light effort.

steps: Fresh authenticated model-free vault; create independent read-only and propose-only principals through token agent, without core:write.
Operator configures a real code-mode runtime and a scripted local provider, with pinned prompt-package fixtures and no private engine calls.
Initialize /mcp; setup_oneiron supplies the board, verb_grammar, instructions and actor-bound non-cacheable metadata.
Execute a scripted vault.recall through the reader credential; inspect the saved public result against the authored preference.
Execute vault.claims.upsert through the proposer credential; observe a proposed claim, its true source, bound actor and gate receipt; recall must not admit the unapproved claim.

Supply another actor in the execute_code actor block and a false user_stated source in the guest proposal; refuse the actor mismatch and reject or host-stamp the source without strengthening its trust.
Attempt an automatic write with the reader and proposal credentials; neither may exceed its tier. Confirm original content and provenance through public reads.
noFallback: Do not substitute a full-access credential, generated tools, a generic facade call or private state for this execute-mode flow.
